references.label: Center saucer
references.description: Saucer that starts the prepared playfield multiplier.

references.label: drop target
references.description: If upper Bonus is ready, hit the lit top-center standup; to collect lower Bonus, lower the single upper drop target and send the ball through the shooter lane.

references.label: left spinner
references.description: With 4x lit, complete the lower-left bank to light 5x Bonus and the left spinner.

references.label: lower-left bank
references.description: Shoot the right in-line drops through 3x Bonus, complete the upper 1-2-3 bank for 4x, then complete the lower-left bank for 5x and both lit spinners.

references.label: Right in-line bank
references.description: Bank that advances Bonus X to 3x.

references.label: right spinner
references.description: Complete the lower-left bank a second time to light the right spinner for 1,000 per spin.

references.label: right standups
references.description: Light all eight lower-playfield colors by hitting the four lower-left drops and both right standups and rolling through both inlanes.

references.label: Left and right spinners
references.description: Repeatable scoring shots after the lower bank lights them.

references.label: Left and right spinners
references.description: Repeatable scoring shots after the lower bank lights them.

references.label: top-center standup
references.description: If upper Bonus is ready, hit the lit top-center standup; to collect lower Bonus, lower the single upper drop target and send the ball through the shooter lane.

references.label: upper drop target
references.description: If upper Bonus is ready, hit the lit top-center standup; to collect lower Bonus, lower the single upper drop target and send the ball through the shooter lane.

references.label: upper targets
references.description: Hit upper targets and rollovers to raise upper Bonus.
